crypto_published_justification: Cryptography and aiohttp supplied by Home Assistant parse and pin the existing paired certificate with SHA-256. The integration requires RSA >=2048, EC >=224 or Ed25519/Ed448 before capture; it verifies the same certificate fingerprint for the HTTPS subresource. This is paired leaf identity verification, not public-CA chain verification. https://github.com/ha-homelab/ha-lg-tv-capture/blob/main/SECURITY.md
